response.rationale: A and B are both built around the same class, ShipmentNotificationService (node 21902eaf2ee28c4a, application layer, notifications component). The two capability names differ only in that B adds "to customers". A's community also includes the domain class Shipment (node e4b465cb4e5c3815). Shipment has fan-in 0, so the graph doesn't record a dependency from ShipmentNotificationService to it. A probably groups it with the service because it is the shipment data being notified about, not because it adds a separate capability. The core behaviour, telling someone that a shipment has been dispatched, is the same in both. The only visible code is the class declarations, so the match rests on the shared class and the near-identical names.
